```{r}
# Import MS2 library
Si16_MS2_library <- parse_library(file_path = system.file("extdata", "StM16_library", "Si11_library_MS2.library", package = "MS1Match"), ionPolarity = "pos",spectrum_type ="MS2")
 
```


```{r}
Si16_MS2_library[[1]]$PreIon
```

## Direct matching to the MS2 library 

We can also use MS2 spectra to perform the direct matching and compare the results from MS1. 

```{r direct-MS2libmatch}
DirectLibMatch_MS2_obj <- createDirectLibMatch(
  FT = result_StM16_FT_filtered,
  compounds_list = Si16_MS2_library,
  diff_mz_thr = 0.01,
  diff_rt_thr = 5,
  ppm = 10,
  ms_level = "MS2",
  polarity = "pos"
)
```



We can now annotate the feature table using the direct MS2 library match:
```{r}

library(doParallel)

# Start a cluster using available cores
n_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
cl <- makeCluster(n_cores)
# 
# # Register it so %dopar% uses it
 registerDoParallel(cl)


direct_match_Stm16_MS2_obj <- libAnnotate(DirectLibMatch_MS2_obj, compute_cosine = TRUE)
```
The result from libAnnotate() is a list containing matched annotations. You can convert it to a data frame for easier inspection:

```{r}
direct_match_Stm16_res_MS2 <- results(direct_match_Stm16_MS2_obj)
```

```{r}
direct_match_Stm16_res_MS2[[1]]
```

## Annotation of MS2-Matched Features

### Import Supporting Tables
We first import the adduct and neutral loss tables:
```{r import-supporting-tables, message=FALSE}
# Load adduct and neutral loss tables
adduct_table <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "Adducts", "adducts.csv", package = "MS1Match"))

neutral_loss_table <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "Neutral loss", "neutral loss database.csv", package = "MS1Match"), check.names = TRUE)
  


```

After identifying candidate features through direct MS1 library matching, we initialize a `PeakAnnotation` S4 object to annotate the features using adducts, neutral losses, and isotopic patterns
```{r}

# Create PeakAnnotation object
PeakAnnotation_MS2_obj <- createPeakAnnotation(compounds = Si16_MS2_library,
                                              FT =  result_StM16_FT_filtered,
                                              neutral_loss_table = neutral_loss_table,
                                              adducts_df = adduct_table,
                                              PI_rt_threshold = 10 ,
                                              polarity = "positive")
```

Finally, we call the `annotate` to generate detailed annotations:
```{r}
StM16_annotate_res_MS2 <- annotate(PeakAnnotation_MS2_obj)
```

```{r}
StM16_annotate_res_MS2[[1]]
```

```{r}
#write.csv(StM16_join_annotation_results_2merge_anno_MS1_MS2, "StM16_join_annotation_results_2merge_anno_MS1_MS2.csv", row.names = F)
library(dplyr)

summary_by_compound_MS1_MS2 <- StM16_join_annotation_results_2merge_anno_MS1_MS2 %>%
  mutate(
    in_MS1 = !is.na(mzmed_MS1),
    in_MS2 = !is.na(mzmed_MS2),
    origin = case_when(
      in_MS1 & in_MS2 ~ "intersection",
      in_MS1 & !in_MS2 ~ "ms1_only",
      !in_MS1 & in_MS2 ~ "ms2_only",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    compound = coalesce(Compound_name_MS1, Compound_name_MS2)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(compound), !is.na(origin)) %>%
  group_by(compound) %>%
  summarise(
    ms1_only = sum(origin == "ms1_only"),
    ms2_only = sum(origin == "ms2_only"),
    intersection = sum(origin == "intersection"),
    total_peaks = n(),
     overlap_pct = 100 * intersection / total_peaks,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_peaks)) %>% 
  
  filter(compound != c("Quercetin", "L-(+)-Alpha-Phenylglycine"))


summary_by_compound_MS1_MS2

```

### stack bar plot

```{r}



plot_df_all_MS1_MS2 <- summary_by_compound_MS1_MS2 %>%
  mutate(compound = fct_reorder(compound, total_peaks)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ms1_only, ms2_only, intersection),
    names_to = "origin",
    values_to = "n_peaks"
  )


ggplot(plot_df_all_MS1_MS2, aes(x = compound, y = n_peaks, fill = origin)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of matched peaks (features)", fill = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      ms1_only = "#76B7B2",
      intersection = "#4E79A7",
      ms2_only = "#F28E2B"
    ),
    breaks = c("ms1_only", "intersection", "ms2_only"),
    labels = c("Unique MS1", "Intersection", "Unique MS2")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16))


```

  )

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

summarize_redundant_features_refined <- function(df, ppm_tol = 10) {

  # --- helpers ---
  ppm_error <- function(obs, ref) abs(obs - ref) / ref * 1e6
  extract_pi_mz <- function(x) as.numeric(str_extract(x, "(?i)([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)(?!.*[0-9])"))

  # Choice A (positive mode): any '-' inside [...] => treat as NL
  has_minus_inside_brackets <- function(x) {
    str_detect(x %||% "", "\\[[^\\]]*-[^\\]]*\\]")
  }

  # --- clean empty strings ---
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA_character_, .x)))

  # --- exclusive feature-level classification (PI counts as Adduct now) ---
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      has_PI  = !is.na(PI_match) & str_trim(PI_match) != "",
      has_iso = !is.na(iso_annotation) &
        str_trim(iso_annotation) != "" &
        str_detect(iso_annotation, "\\[M\\+\\d+\\]"),

      # Choice A: NL column OR '-' inside bracketed ion in adduct column
      has_NL  = (!is.na(NL_match) & str_trim(NL_match) != "") |
        (!is.na(adduct_match) & str_trim(adduct_match) != "" &
           has_minus_inside_brackets(adduct_match)),

      # Adduct now includes PI OR any adduct_match
      has_adduct_any =
        (!is.na(adduct_match) & str_trim(adduct_match) != "") |
        has_PI,

      # IMPORTANT: PI removed as its own category
      feature_class = case_when(
        has_NL ~ "NL",
        has_adduct_any ~ "Adduct",
        has_iso ~ "Isotope",
        TRUE ~ "Unannotated"
      )
    )

  # --- group-level exclusive totals (these now sum without PI column) ---
  group_totals <- df %>%
    group_by(Lib_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_features_total        = n(),
      n_features_with_NL      = sum(feature_class == "NL"),
      n_features_with_adduct  = sum(feature_class == "Adduct"),
      n_iso_features          = sum(feature_class == "Isotope"),
      n_unannotated_features  = sum(feature_class == "Unannotated"),
      perc_unannotated        = round(100 * n_unannotated_features / n_features_total, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- compound map (one row per PI per group) ---
  compound_map <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(PI_match), str_trim(PI_match) != "") %>%
    distinct(Lib_group, PI_match) %>%
    mutate(PI_mz = extract_pi_mz(PI_match))

  if (nrow(compound_map) == 0L) {
    warning("No compounds with PI_match found.")
    return(group_totals)
  }

  # --- valid adduct feature count per PI (unchanged logic) ---
  adduct_long <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(adduct_match), str_trim(adduct_match) != "") %>%
    select(Lib_group, feature_name, adduct_match) %>%
    mutate(adduct_split = str_split(adduct_match, ";\\s*")) %>%
    unnest_longer(adduct_split, values_to = "adduct_entry") %>%
    mutate(
      adduct_entry  = str_trim(adduct_entry),
      adduct_label  = str_extract(adduct_entry, "\\[[^\\]]+\\]"),
      adduct_ref_mz = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(adduct_entry, "([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)\\s*$")))
    )

  adduct_eval <- compound_map %>%
    nest_join(adduct_long, by = "Lib_group") %>%
    unnest(cols = c(adduct_long)) %>%
    mutate(
      adduct_ppm_vs_PI = ifelse(!is.na(adduct_ref_mz) & !is.na(PI_mz),
                                ppm_error(adduct_ref_mz, PI_mz), NA_real_),
      adduct_is_valid_for_PI = case_when(
        is.na(adduct_ref_mz) ~ NA,
        adduct_ppm_vs_PI <= ppm_tol ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      )
    )

  adduct_summary_min <- adduct_eval %>%
    group_by(Lib_group, PI_match) %>%
    summarise(
      n_valid_adduct_features = n_distinct(feature_name[adduct_is_valid_for_PI %in% TRUE]),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # --- final lean output ---
  final <- compound_map %>%
    left_join(group_totals, by = "Lib_group") %>%
    left_join(adduct_summary_min, by = c("Lib_group", "PI_match")) %>%
    mutate(n_valid_adduct_features = replace_na(n_valid_adduct_features, 0)) %>%
    select(
      Lib_group,
      PI_match,
      n_features_total,
      
      n_features_with_adduct,
      n_features_with_NL,
      n_iso_features,
      n_unannotated_features,
      perc_unannotated,
      n_valid_adduct_features
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_features_total))

  return(final)
}

```
